blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) is a long-established problem that aims to detect defects in industrial products during manufacturing for quality control. Most existing studies focus on static visual patterns as the basis for detection. However, in real manufacturing environments, many anomalies are dynamics-based, such as irregular movements that cannot be perceived from static cues alone. We observe that even recent Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based approaches fall short in identifying such dynamic anomalies due to limited temporal modeling capability. To address this, we introduce MUSTARD: MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a framework that equips MLLMs with fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamics awareness for detecting and reasoning about dynamics-based defects. MUSTARD introduces optical-flow-guided keyframe selection and augmented modalities to capture critical motion irregularities through local motion patterns and global dynamic evolution. Its normal pattern-based reasoning pipeline requires only a few normal reference samples as the detection basis, avoiding any model updates. This enables efficient adaptation across various products and provides high decision interpretability. MUSTARD is the first MLLM-based framework for dynamics-based IAD. Experiments demonstrate its superior performance in detecting spatiotemporal anomalies and providing plausible explanations. The code will be made publicly available.
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测(IAD)是一个长期存在的问题,旨在检测制造过程中用于质量控制的工业产品缺陷. 大多数现有的研究都以静态视觉模式作为检测的基础. 然而,在真实的制造环境中,许多异常现象都是基于动态的,例如不能仅从静态提示中看出的不规则移动. 我们注意到,即使是最近基于多式联运的大语言模型(MLLM)的方法,由于时间建模能力有限,也未能发现这种动态异常。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了MUSTARD:MUltimodule SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection,这个框架使MLLMs具备精细的振荡动态意识,用于探测和推理基于动态的缺陷. MUSTARD引入了光学流导键框选择和增强模式,通过局部运动模式和全球动态演化来捕捉关键运动异常. 其正常的基于模式的推理管道只需要几个正常的参考样本作为检测基础,避免任何模型更新. 这有助于在各种产品中进行有效的适应,并具有较高的决策解释性。 MUSTARD是第一个基于MLLM的基于动态的IAD框架. 实验证明它在检测瞬间异常和提供合理解释方面表现优异。 守则将公开发布。

blocks.en: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) is a crucial problem that aims to automatically inspect product defects in manufacturing environments. Most existing IAD benchmarks [ 4 , 11 , 42 , 3 , 26 ] , and approaches [ 38 , 34 , 6 , 13 ] focus on static visual defects, e.g., a missing chunk on a candle or a bulge on the side of a bowl. These static anomalies can be identified from a single image. However, in real production lines, many anomalies are driven by dynamic irregularities, such as irregular rotations, abnormal vibrations, and unexpected component interactions, which cannot be captured from static cues alone. Inspecting such dynamics-based anomalies requires physical operations. For example, a fan may appear visually flawless from a static observation, but we need to turn it on to see whether it rotates smoothly or gets stuck. Although modern smart factories have been able to leverage robot arms to automate these tests, we still lack an effective IAD algorithm capable of inspecting dynamic anomalies from the resulting test videos, which requires fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamic understanding. Advancing such robot perception capabilities is crucial for seamless integration with robotic arm operations, enabling a fully automated smart manufacturing process.
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测(IAD)是一个关键问题,旨在自动检查制造环境中的产品缺陷. 大多数现有的内审司基准[4, 11, 42, 3, 26], 以及方法[38, 34, 6, 13] 侧重于静态视觉缺陷, 例如蜡烛上缺失的块或碗边的凸起. 这些静态异常可以从单一图像中识别出. 然而,在活性生产线中,许多异常都是由动态异常所驱动的,例如不规则的旋转,异常的振动,以及出乎意料的元件相互作用,这些现象不能单独从静态提示中捕捉到. 检查这些基于动态的异常需要物理操作. 例如,一个风扇可能从静态观察中看起来是无瑕疵的,但我们需要打开它,看看它是平稳地旋转还是被卡住. 虽然现代智能工厂已经能够利用机器人臂来使这些测试自动化,但是我们仍然缺乏一个有效的ID算法,能够检查所生成的测试视频的动态异常,这需要精细的分光活性能的理解. 提高这种机器人感知能力对于与机器人臂操作的无缝结合至关重要,能够实现完全自动化的智能制造过程.

blocks.en: Existing IAD approaches face fundamental limitations. Traditional convolutional network–based methods employ self-supervised pretext tasks, such as image reconstruction, to model normal patterns [ 38 , 34 , 19 ] . CLIP-based frameworks [ 13 , 6 , 41 ] leverage vision-language semantic alignment to achieve few-shot or zero-shot IAD. Nevertheless, both streams consider only static defects and thus rely primarily on static visual attributes. In addition, they provide only anomaly scores, without interpretable rationales, to users. While recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various vision tasks [ 16 , 1 ] , they still fall short in dynamics-based IAD [ 35 ] . We observe that a key reason stems from dynamic patterns unfolding over multiple video frames. For instance, determining whether a gear rotates correctly requires capturing motion across consecutive frames; a single snapshot cannot reveal whether the gear is stuck, rotating incorrectly, or moving at an improper speed. Similarly, detecting abnormal vibrations or timing misalignments necessitates capturing the temporal evolution of system behavior. However, current MLLMs tend to overlook or fail to prioritize critical anomalous dynamics. We reveal that even video-oriented MLLMs [ 15 , 39 ] lack an effective mechanism to explicitly model frame-to-frame temporal changes (see Fig. 1 -(1)), making it difficult to detect subtle variations such as gradual slowdowns or slight trajectory deviations. Moreover, most MLLMs employ uniform frame sampling to reduce computational cost. Although uniform sampling may be sufficient for general video understanding tasks, it fundamentally limits their ability to capture fine-grained temporal anomalies.
blocks.zh: 现有的内审司办法面临根本限制。 传统革命网络-基于方法使用自我监督的借口任务,如图像重建,来模拟正常模式[38,34,19]. 基于CLIP的框架 [13, 6, 41] 利用视觉语言语义的对接,实现几发或零发的IAD. 尽管如此,两条流只考虑静态缺陷,因此主要依赖静态视觉属性. 此外,它们只向用户提供异常分数,没有可解释的理由. 虽然多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)最近的进展表明,在各种愿景任务[16,1]中,它们的能力显著,但在基于动态的IAD[35]中仍然不足。 我们观察到,一个关键的原因是 动态模式在多个视频框中出现。 例如,确定齿轮旋转是否正确,需要捕捉跨相继帧的运动;单一快照无法显示齿轮是被卡住,旋转不正确,还是以不适当的速度移动. 同样地,检测异常振动或时间错位需要捕捉系统行为的时间演化. 然而,目前的MLLMs往往忽略或未能优先考虑关键的异常动态。 我们揭示出,即使是面向视频的MLLMs[15,39],也缺乏一个明确模拟帧至帧时间变化的有效机制(见图1-(1)),因此难以发现诸如逐渐减速或微小的轨迹偏差等微妙变化. 此外,大多数MLLMs采用统一的帧采样来降低计算成本. 虽然统一取样可能足以完成一般的视频理解任务,但从根本上限制了它们捕捉细纹时间异常的能力.

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we posit that optical flow, which encodes pixel-level motion between consecutive frames, provides a rich yet underutilized signal for dynamics-based IAD. Flow-based directional arrows reveal local movement trajectories, enabling the tracking of object positions and rotations over time. The flow magnitude represents global motion speed, and its variation highlights critical state transitions, such as when components start moving, stop, or change velocity. By converting optical flow into interpretable visual and statistical representations, we provide MLLMs with explicit temporal dynamics information that complements static frame content.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们假定,光学流动在连续帧之间编码像素级运动,为基于动态的ID提供了丰富而利用不足的信号。 以流为主的方向箭头会揭示出局部的运动轨迹,从而能够跟踪物体位置并随时间推移而旋转. 流量代表了全局运动速度,其变异凸显出临界状态过渡,例如组件开始移动,停止,或改变速度时. 通过将光学流转化为可解释的视觉和统计表现,我们向MLLMs提供明确的时间动态信息,以补充静态框架内容.

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose MUSTARD: MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a novel framework that equips MLLMs with optical flow-guided spatiotemporal dynamics awareness, enabling accurate detection and reasoning of dynamic anomalies (see Fig. 1 -(2)). MUSTARD features three key innovations: (1) an optical flow-guided keyframe selection strategy that precisely samples frames containing critical motion irregularities; (2) two auxiliary optical flow–augmented modalities, including trajectory-overlaid video frames annotated with local motion patterns using directional arrows and a flow magnitude curve representing global dynamic evolution; and (3) a normal pattern–based reasoning pipeline that extracts normal patterns from a small set of reference data as the decision basis, providing plausible anomaly explanations. The entire pipeline adheres to the one-class IAD (a.k.a. semi-supervised IAD) setting, in which only normal training samples are available, and no anomaly knowledge is leaked.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出MUSTARD:MUltilmodule SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reason and Detection,这是一种新颖的框架,它使MLLMs具备了光学流导分流动态意识,从而能够准确检测和推理动态异常(见图1-(2))。 MUSTARD有三项关键创新:(1) 光学流导键框选择策略,精确地取出包含临界运动异常的帧;(2) 两种辅助光学流导-增强模式,包括用方向箭头和代表全球动态演变的流量曲线附加了局部运动规律的轨迹覆盖的相机;(3) 一种正常模式-基于推理管道,从一小组参考数据中提取出正常模式作为决策基础,提供可信的异常解释。 整个管道都坚持一等IAD(a.k.a.半监督IAD)设置,其中只有普通的训练样本,没有异常知识被泄露.

blocks.en: In addition, MUSTARD is a few-normal-shot [ 32 ] method that uses only a small number of normal samples from the training set as references to extract normal patterns for IAD. This eliminates the need for expensive full-shot training on the entire dataset and does not require any model weight updates, enabling efficient adaptation to various industrial product lines in real manufacturing scenarios. We evaluate our method on Phys-AD [ 14 ] and IPAD [ 17 ] , the two pioneering dynamics-based IAD benchmarks available in the literature. Extensive experiments demonstrate MUSTARD’s state-of-the-art detection performance and reasoning ability. The main contributions are threefold: • We propose one of the first MLLM-based frameworks for dynamics-based IAD, addressing challenges beyond static IAD and augmenting automation in manufacturing. • We introduce a novel optical-flow-guided spatiotemporal dynamics awareness method, enabling accurate detection and reasoning of dynamic anomalies. • The proposed normal pattern-based reasoning pipeline allows efficient adaptation to various industrial products, which is highly practical for real production lines.
blocks.zh: 此外,MUSTARD是一种多常射出[32]的方法,它只使用训练集中少量的正常样本作为参考来提取IAD的正常模式. 这就不再需要对整个数据集进行昂贵的全镜头培训,也不需要任何模型重量更新,从而能够在实际制造情景中有效地适应各种工业产品线。 我们评价我们关于Phys-AD [14] 和 IPAD [17] 的方法,这是文献中现有的以动态为基础的两个开创性IAD基准. 广泛的实验展示了MUSTARD最先进的探测性能和推理能力. • 主要贡献有三: 我们提议为基于动态的IAD制定基于MLLM的首批框架之一,以应对静态IAD以外的挑战并增强制造业的自动化。 我们引进了一种新的光学-流导-相位动态感知方法,从而能够准确检测和推理动态异常。 拟议的以规律为基础的正常推理管道能够有效地适应各种工业产品,这对真正的生产线是十分实际的。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Industrial Anomaly Detection. IAD focuses on products, equipment, and manufacturing processes under controlled conditions. Most existing IAD studies operate at the image level, aiming to detect texture or structural defects in static settings. Typical approaches include autoencoder-based reconstruction (e.g., DRAEM [ 38 ] , UniAD [ 34 ] , PrincipaLS [ 19 ] ), CLIP-based vision-language alignment [ 22 ] (e.g., WinCLIP [ 13 ] , AdaCLIP [ 6 ] , AnomalyCLIP [ 41 ] ), and recent MLLM-based frameworks (e.g., AnomalyGPT [ 9 ] , Anomaly-OV [ 31 ] , Anomaly-LR [ 33 ] ). However, dynamics-based IAD remains largely unexplored. Specifically, existing approaches rarely incorporate motion continuity, causal reasoning, or temporal cues, which are crucial for detecting dynamic anomalies such as slippage, detachment, or collision. Recently, Phys-AD [ 14 ] and IPAD [ 17 ] have been introduced as benchmarks for dynamics-based industrial anomalies. Concurrent to our work, O-VAD [ 35 ] uses object-centric state tracking and reasoning, but it is less effective on subtle motion cues and fast state transitions.
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测. 内部审计司的重点是在控制条件下的产品、设备和制造工艺。 现有的大多数内部审计员协会研究都在图像层面运作,目的是检测静态环境中的纹理或结构缺陷。 典型的方法包括基于自动编码器的重建(如DRAEM [38],UniAD [34],Principals [19]),基于CLIP的视觉语言对接[22](如WinCLIP [13],AdaCLIP [6],AnomalyCLIP [41]),以及基于MLLM的近期框架(如AnomalyGPT [9],Anomaly-OV [31],Anomaly-LR [33]). 然而,基于动态的内部审计师协会基本上仍未探讨。 具体地说,现有方法很少包括运动连续性、因果推理或时间提示,这对于发现动态异常,例如滑行、分解或相撞至关重要。 最近,Phys-AD[14]和IPAD[17]被引入作为基于动态的工业异常的基准. 与我们的工作同时期,O-VAD[35]采用了以对象为中心的状态跟踪和推理,但在微妙的运动提示和快速状态过渡上效果较差.

blocks.en: Video Anomaly Detection. Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) targets human-centric surveillance scenes. Existing approaches can be grouped into three main categories: autoencoder-based, CLIP-based, and MLLM-based frameworks. Autoencoder-based methods (e.g., MemAE [ 8 ] , MNAD [ 21 ] ) learn normal appearance patterns from surveillance videos and detect deviations through reconstruction or prediction errors. CLIP-based methods (e.g., VadCLIP [ 30 ] ) leverage vision–language alignment to score anomalous events. Recent MLLM-based frameworks (e.g., LAVAD [ 37 ] , AnomalyRuler [ 32 ] , HAWK [ 23 ] , Holmes-VAU [ 40 ] ) integrate visual features with LLMs to detect anomalies. These VAD studies primarily focus on human-centric surveillance videos that are largely static, where most anomalous events can be identified from static appearance cues. In contrast, dynamics-based IAD videos are fast-paced and object-centric, requiring finer spatiotemporal granularity. Hence, VAD approaches are not directly applicable.
blocks.zh: 视频异常检测. 视频异常检测(VAD)针对以人为中心的监视场景. 现有办法可分为三大类:基于自动编码器、基于CLIP和基于MLLM的框架。 以自动编码器为基础的方法(如:MemAE [8],MNAD [21])从监视视频中学习出正常的外观模式,并通过重建或预测错误来检测偏差. 基于CLIP的方法(如:VadCLIP [30]) 杠杆视觉-语言对接以得分异常事件. 最近基于MLLM的框架(例如:LAVAD [37], Anomaly Ruder [32],HAWK [23],Holmes-VAU [40])将视觉特征与LLMs相融合以检测异常. 这些VAD研究主要侧重于以人为中心的监控视频,这些视频大多是静态的,从静态外观提示可以识别出大多数异常事件. 相形之下,基于动态的IAD视频速度快并以对象为中心,需要更精细的spatiotemporal颗粒. 因此,脆弱性和适应方法并不直接适用。

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models. MLLMs have recently demonstrated strong general reasoning capabilities across vision–language tasks, with representative model families including LLaVA [ 16 ] , Qwen-VL [ 1 , 2 ] , InternVL [ 28 ] , and Seed-VL [ 5 ] . However, for video tasks, most models still overlook fine-grained temporal cues, relying on uniformly sampled frames or static summaries (e.g., VideoLLaMA [ 39 ] , Video-LLaVA [ 15 ] ). This results in appearance-centric reasoning that neglects subtle temporal dynamics and causal patterns crucial for dynamics-based IAD. Recent attempts, such as StimuVAR [ 10 ] and AKS [ 24 ] , introduce keyframe selection and token sampling strategies to enhance temporal awareness in MLLMs for video understanding. However, these approaches are designed for generic video tasks and offer limited effectiveness in short, motion-sensitive anomaly scenarios, where fine-grained spatiotemporal cues are essential yet insufficiently explored.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型. 最近,MLLMs在视觉-语言任务中表现出了强大的一般推理能力,具有代表性的模范家庭包括LLaVA[16]、Quen-VL[1,2]、InternVL[28]和Seed-VL[5]。 然而,对于视频任务,大多数模型仍然忽略了精细的时间提示,依赖于统一的被取样的帧或静态摘要(例如VideoLLaMA [39],Video-LlaVA [15]. 这导致了以外观为中心的推理,而这种推理忽视了微妙的时间动态和对基于动态的内测数据至关重要的因果关系模式。 近期的尝试,如StimuVAR [10]和AKS [24],引入了关键框架选择和符号采样策略来提高MLLMs中的时间意识以进行视频理解. 然而,这些方法是为一般的视频任务而设计的,在短短的、对运动敏感的异常情景中,效力有限,在这种情景中,精细的瞬间提示至关重要,但探索不足。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Definition
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题定义

blocks.en: We address the dynamics-based IAD problem under the one-class setting. The model is provided with a small number of normal industrial product inspection videos containing dynamic processes. From these normal-only videos, the objective is to learn a comprehensive representation of spatiotemporal normal behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们在一等环境下处理基于动态的内审司问题。 该模型提供了少量包含动态过程的正常工业产品检验视频. 从这些平凡而唯能的视频中,目的是学习全面表现spatiopal正常行为.

blocks.en: When presented with a previously unseen test video, the model must determine whether it deviates from the learned normal patterns. The output is twofold: (1) a numerical anomaly score and (2) a coherent, human-interpretable natural language explanation that justifies the score. This formulation strictly adheres to the industrial scenario, where anomalous samples are typically unavailable, and both a quantitative score and an interpretable rationale are essential for practical deployment.
blocks.zh: 当呈现出之前未见的测试视频时,模型必须确定它是否偏离所学到的正常模式. 输出有双重: (1)数值异常分和(2)连贯地,由人解释的自然语言解释,证明分数合理. 这种提法严格遵循工业假设,即通常没有异常样品,而且定量分数和可解释的理由对实际部署至关重要。

blocks.en: 3.2 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 框架概览

blocks.en: To address the challenge of detecting dynamics-based anomalies, which are often overlooked by existing MLLMs, we propose MUSTARD: Multimodal Spatiotemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a novel training-free framework that equips models with explicit spatiotemporal awareness. Our core insight is that by translating implicit temporal motion information in videos into explicit textual representations, we enable MLLMs to reason about complex physical dynamics.
blocks.zh: 为了应对探测动态异常的挑战,这些异常经常被现有的MLLM所忽略,我们提议采用MUSTARD:多模式Spatiotemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection,这是一种新的无培训框架,使模型具有明确的瞬间意识。 我们的核心见解是,通过将视频中隐含的时动信息转化为明确的文字表述,我们使得MLLM能够对复杂的物理动态进行推理.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , the proposed MUSTARD framework consists of three main stages. (1) Spatiotemporal Dynamics Awareness . This stage processes a raw input video to extract rich, motion-aware information. It leverages optical flow to select keyframes and derive three complementary descriptive modalities: raw frames for visual context, trajectory frames for visualizing local motion, and a flow magnitude curve for representing global temporal dynamics. (2) Normal Pattern Extraction . This stage operates in a few-normal-shot paradigm, extracting multi-faceted normal patterns from a small set of reference videos. (3) Pattern Reasoning . During inference, the model compares the test video’s description with the extracted normal patterns to detect deviations, fusing evidence from all three modalities to produce a final anomaly judgment and explanation.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,拟议的MUSTARD框架包括三个主要阶段。 (1) 空间动态意识。 这个舞台处理一个原始输入视频来取出丰富的,有运动意识的信息. 它利用光学流来选择键框并衍生出三种互补的描述方式:视觉上下文活框,可视化局部运动的轨迹相框,以及代表全球时间动态的流量曲线. blocks.en: 3.3 Spatiotemporal Dynamics Awareness
blocks.zh: 3.3 空间动态意识

blocks.en: This stage aims to fully exploit spatiotemporal information in a video to capture fine-grained dynamics-based anomalies. We first approach this from the perspective of global temporal dynamics. Uniform frame sampling is a standard practice in deep learning models, including MLLMs [ 39 , 15 ] , for video processing, as it significantly reduces computational cost. However, such uniform sampling overlooks key timesteps that are crucial for detecting abnormal dynamics. To address this limitation, we propose to adopt keyframe selection [ 10 , 24 ] to capture critical timesteps while maintaining the same number of frames. These critical timesteps are intrinsically well-suited to modeling via optical flow estimation. Specifically, we employ the Dual TV-L1 optical flow algorithm [ 36 ] to derive pixel-level dense motion between each pair of adjacent frames in the input video. By aggregating the mean flow magnitudes for each frame, we construct a flow magnitude curve that depicts the intensity of optical flow over time (see Fig. 2 ). Acting as a temporal fingerprint of the video’s overall global dynamics, this curve enables the selection of keyframes corresponding to dynamically significant moments: peaks (maximum motion), valleys (minimum motion), and shoulders (transitional phases). This ensures that the fixed frame sampling budget is allocated to the frames most informative for understanding temporal evolution.
blocks.zh: 这一阶段旨在从视频中充分挖掘spatiotal信息,以捕捉出精细的以动态为基础的异常. 我们首先从全球时间动态的角度看待这个问题。 统一帧采样是深层学习模型中的一种标准做法,包括MLLMs [39,15],用于视频处理,因为它能显著地降低计算成本. 然而,这种统一的抽样忽略了对发现异常动态至关重要的关键时间步骤。 为了解决这一限制,我们提议采用关键框架选择[10、24],以抓住关键的时间步骤,同时保持相同数量的框架。 这些关键的时序在本质上非常适合通过光学流估计进行建模. 具体地说,我们使用Dual TV-L1光学流算法[36]在输入视频中每对相邻帧之间得出像素级密集运动. 通过汇总每个相框的平均流度,我们构建出一个流度曲线来描绘随着时间的推移光学流的强度(见图2)。 这个曲线作为视频总体全球动态的时空指纹, 能够选择与动态重要时刻相对应的关键框架:高峰(最大运动)、谷地(最小运动)和肩部(过渡阶段)。 这确保了固定框架抽样预算被分配给最能了解时间演变情况的框架。

blocks.en:
Next, based on the derived optical flow, we construct three complementary modalities for the selected keyframes to further enrich the spatiotemporal context (see Fig. 3 ). (1) Raw frames : The original keyframes capture the key “what” and “where” of the scene. (2) Trajectory frames : We capture local motion by overlaying optical-flow directional arrows onto the frames. The arrow size represents motion magnitude, and trailing lines render the motion path history.
We initialize uniformly distributed probe points on the first frame and propagate each point through consecutive frames by sampling the local TV-L1 optical-flow vector at its current position, forming continuous motion trajectories.
To ensure object-centric annotations, we apply the Farthest Point Sampling [ 7 ] strategy to select a stable and informative subset of points for arrow rendering.(3) Flow magnitude curve : The same curve used for keyframe selection, capturing the global temporal dynamics of the entire video. Then, we employ an MLLM to generate text descriptions for each modality, encoding their spatiotemporal information in natural language. The raw frame description focuses on static visual details, such as the main objects, their parts, and their surroundings; the trajectory frame description captures local motion; and the flow magnitude curve description focuses on global temporal dynamics, acting as a plot reader that provides a structured 13-field textual summary (e.g., maximum magnitude, number of peaks, magnitude trends). The complete modality-description prompts, including the 13-field
flow-magnitude summary format, is provided in Appendix A7. Each source exhibits distinct strengths, and we integrate them to complement each other.
blocks.zh:
其次,根据衍生的光学流,我们为选定的关键框架构建了三种互补模式,以进一步丰富时空背景(见图3)。 (1) 原始框架: 最初的关键框架包括现场的关键“什么”和“在哪里”。 (2) 轨距: 我们通过将光学流向箭头覆盖到相框上来捕捉局部运动. 箭头大小代表运动星等,后行会使运动路径成为历史.
我们在第一个帧上启动统一分布的探测点,并通过连续帧传播每个点,对当地TV-L1光流矢量按当前位置取样,形成连续运动轨迹。
为了确保以对象为中心的说明,我们采用最远点采样[7]策略来选择一个稳定且信息丰富的点子集来进行箭头渲染. (3)流度曲线: 用于键框选择的同一种曲线,捕捉了整个视频的全球时间动态. 然后,我们使用一个MLLM来生成每种模式的文本描述,用自然语言来编码它们的瞬间信息. 原始框架描述侧重于静态视觉细节,如主要物体,其部分,及其周围;轨迹框架描述能捕捉局部运动;而流量曲线描述则侧重于全球时间动态,充当图解读取器,提供结构化的13字段文字摘要(如最大分量,峰值数,量级趋势等). 完整的模式描述提示,包括13字段
流程宽度摘要格式见附录A7。 每个来源都表现出不同的长处,我们将它们结合起来,相互补充。

blocks.en: 3.4 Normal Pattern Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.4 普通采掘图案

blocks.en: The proposed MUSTARD framework adheres to the strict one-class setting via a few-normal-shot paradigm, learning normal patterns from a small set of reference normal videos. In our problem, inspection videos may exhibit varying conditions, such as differences in color and operating angle, even for the same product. We therefore aim to extract normal patterns that summarize the reference videos, capturing such variations while aligning descriptions across different videos to form a more robust reference representation.
blocks.zh: 所拟议的MUSTARD框架通过几个正常的镜头范式,坚持严格的一等设定,从一小组参考正常视频中学习出正常模式. 在我们的问题中,检查录像可能呈现出不同的条件,例如颜色和操作角度的不同,即使是同一产品。 因此,我们力求抽取正常模式,总结参考录像,捕捉这些差异,同时调整不同录像的描述,形成更强有力的参考表现。

blocks.en: Specifically, we take a small set of normal training videos as references and apply the Spatiotemporal Dynamics Awareness process to obtain trajectory frame descriptions and flow magnitude curve descriptions for each video. We then adopt a position-wise consolidation strategy to extract robust normal patterns across videos. First, for each ordered keyframe position, we aggregate descriptions across reference videos and query an LLM to produce a shared pattern. Keyframes at the same position are expected to capture a similar state across videos. Next, we concatenate these timestep-wise patterns in temporal order and query the LLM to summarize them into global normal patterns, preserving the overall temporal structure of the process. The resulting trajectory frame patterns and flow magnitude curve patterns serve as robust references for detecting dynamics-based anomalies during inference (see Fig. 2 ). The prompts for normal pattern extraction are provided in Appendix A7.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,我们把一小组普通的训练录像作为参考,并应用Spatiotemporal Dynamics感知过程来获得每个录像的轨迹框架描述和流度曲线描述. 然后,我们采取一个定位整合战略,从视频中提取稳健的正常模式。 首先,对于每个按键框位置,我们汇总各种参考视频的描述,并查询一个LLM,以生成一个共享的图案. 位于同一位置的键框预计将在视频中捕捉到相似的状态. 接下来,我们按时间顺序整理这些时间步态,并询问LLM,将它们归纳为全球正常态,保持整个过程的时间结构. 由此产生的轨迹框架模式和流量曲线模式可作为在推论期间发现基于动态的异常的有力参考(见图2)。 附录A7提供了正常模式提取的提示。

blocks.en: 3.5 Pattern Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.5 模式

blocks.en: At inference time, we apply the same Spatiotemporal Dynamics Awareness process to obtain descriptions of the three modalities for each test video. We then perform pattern reasoning via the LLM, where the trajectory and flow magnitude descriptions are compared against their corresponding normal patterns derived from the Normal Pattern Extraction stage. This comparison produces modality-specific anomaly scores along with structured natural language justifications grounded in temporal dynamics.
blocks.zh: 推论时,我们采用同样的Spatiotemporal Dynamics感知程序,以获得每个测试视频三种模式的描述. 然后,我们通过LLM进行图案推理,将轨迹和流度描述与从正常图案提取阶段得出的相应正常图案进行比较。 这种比较产生特定模式的异常分数,以及基于时间动态的结构化自然语言理由.

blocks.en:
Crucially, the LLM further performs cross-modal evidence fusion by jointly reasoning over these modality-specific outputs together with the raw frame description (see Fig. 2 ). Through this unified reasoning process, it weighs complementary signals from raw visual context, local motion trajectories, and global temporal dynamics to generate a final anomaly score and coherent explanation. This enables principled dynamics-based anomaly detection with interpretable decision-making. The prompts for frame descriptions, pattern reasoning, anomaly-score generation, and
cross-modal fusion are provided in Appendix A7.
blocks.zh:
关键是,LLM通过对这些特定模式的产出与原始框架描述进行联合推理,进一步进行跨模式证据组合(见图2)。 通过这种统一的推理过程,它从原始视觉背景,局部运动轨迹,以及全球时间动态中来权衡互补信号,以产生最终的异常分和连贯的解释. 这使得能够以有原则的动态为基础的异常情况探测,并作出可解释的决策。 框架描述、模式推理、异常分数生成和

blocks.en: Datasets. Phys-AD [ 14 ] is the first large-scale, physics-grounded video dataset for industrial anomaly detection, focusing on anomalies revealed through physical interaction and dynamics rather than static defects. The dataset contains over 6,400 videos across 22 object categories (e.g., gears, rubber bands) and 47 anomaly types, requiring models to reason about physical properties like elasticity and friction. To demonstrate the generalization of our method, we also evaluate on the IPAD [ 17 ] dataset. It is a specialized industrial benchmark that emphasizes the periodicity of equipment operations. It comprises 597,979 frames across 16 industrial devices, and 39 anomaly classes covering appearance, position, and motion-based failures.
blocks.zh: 数据集. Phys-AD [14]是首个用于工业异常探测的大型,以物理为主的视频数据集,主要关注通过物理相互作用和动力学而不是静态缺陷所揭示的异常. 数据集包含超过6400个视频,涉及22个对象类别(如齿轮,橡胶带等)和47个异常类型,需要模型对弹性和摩擦等物理特性进行推理. 为了展示我们方法的通俗化,我们还评估了IPAD[17]数据集. 这是一项专门的工业基准,强调设备运行周期。 它包括涵盖16个工业装置的597 979个框架和涵盖外观、位置和运动故障的39个异常类。

PAEval is given ranging from 0 to 1, higher score means better quality of anomaly explanation. • LLM-as-a-Judge : We evaluated our best method with other methods using LLM-as-a-Judge, where a powerful LLM (GPT-4o [ 12 ] ) is used to pairwise compare two anomaly explanation, based on the ground-truth video descriptions in the Phys-AD dataset.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Detection Performance on Phys-AD. Table 1 presents the AUC performance of primary anomaly detection frameworks on the Phys-AD dataset. Our method achieves an AUC of 0.681, outperforming all MLLM-based baselines by 0.078 and exceeding the state-of-the-art method by 0.012. Notably, the SOTA approach requires full-shot training and provides no anomaly explanations, whereas our method operates in a few-normal-shot manner without full training while delivering superior anomaly detection performance.
In our architecture, Qwen2.5-VL-7B serves as the primary MLLM backbone for essential video-to-text tasks. However, in Table 1 we can see that directly obtaining video descriptions and querying Qwen2.5-VL-7B to determine if the description is ”anomalous or not”, is insufficient for accurate detection. This limitation arises because the model’s inherent, general-purpose knowledge of anomalies often fails to align with the highly specific physical and operational constraints of industrial scenarios, highlighting the fundamental difficulty of zero-shot reasoning in this domain. In contrast, our few-normal-shot paradigm leverages normal exemplars to establish domain-specific anomaly criteria, enabling effective detection without extensive training.
Notably, current video anomaly detection (VAD) methods are inferior to handle fine-grained spatiotemporal anomalies in industrial settings. Previous approaches predominantly focus on anomalies detectable within single frames such as surveillance anomaly detection, which fail entirely in physical industrial scenes that require temporal information. Our framework successfully addresses this gap by incorporating flow-annotated frames and flow magnitude curves to capture essential temporal dynamics, enabling accurate detection of motion-dependent anomalies that manifest across multiple frames.
blocks.zh:
检测Phys-AD的性能. 表1列示了Phys-AD数据集主要异常检测框架的AUC性能. 我们的方法达到了0.681的AUC,比所有基于MLLM的基线多出0.078分,比最先进的方法多出0.012分. 值得注意的是,SOTA方法需要全弹射训练,不提供异常解释,而我们的方法则在不进行充分训练的情况下以少数正常射击方式运作,同时提供优异的异常探测性能.
在我们的建筑中,Quen2.5-VL-7B是基本的视频到文本任务的主要MLLM主干. 然而,在表1中,我们可以看到,直接获取视频描述和查询Quen2.5-VL-7B以确定描述是否“异常”,不足以准确检测。 这一限制之所以产生,是因为该模型对异常现象的内在的、通用的知识往往不能与工业情景中非常具体的物理和操作限制相一致,突出表明了这一领域零发推理的根本困难。 相形之下,我们为数不多的正常镜头范式利用了正常的范例来建立特定域的异常标准,使得无需广泛训练就能有效检测.
值得注意的是,目前的视频异常检测方法低于工业环境中处理细纹斑点异常的方法。 以前的做法主要侧重于在单一框架内可发现的异常现象,例如监视异常现象探测,这些异常现象在需要时间信息的物理工业场景中完全失效。 我们的框架成功地解决了这一差距,纳入了流动附加说明的框架和流动量级曲线,以捕捉必要的时间动态,从而能够准确检测跨多帧的、依赖运动的异常现象。

blocks.en: Generalization to IPAD. To further evaluate the robustness of our framework, we test MUSTARD on the IPAD dataset. As shown in Table 2 , IPAD presents an exceptionally challenging environment where general-purpose MLLMs often perform near or below the level of random chance ( 0.50 0.50 ). This is likely due to the complex periodicity and subtle motion-based failures inherent in large-scale industrial equipment. Despite these challenges, MUSTARD achieves an AUROC of 0.572 , surpass all the baselines. This performance confirms that our spatiotemporal awareness module provides a critical signal for detecting anomalies in long-form industrial processes, even when global motion patterns are highly complex.
blocks.zh: 通化为IPAD. 为了进一步评价我们框架的稳健性,我们在IPAD数据集上测试MUSTARD. 如表2所显示的,IPAD呈现出一种极具挑战性的环境,即一般用途的MLLM经常在接近或低于随机机会水平(0.50 0.50. 这可能是由于大规模工业设备固有的复杂周期和微妙的运动故障。 尽管存在这些挑战,MUSTARD还是实现了0.572的AUROC,超过了所有基线. 这一性能证实了我们的spatiental感知模块为发现长形式工业工艺中的异常提供了关键信号,即使全球运动模式高度复杂.

blocks.en: Anomaly Explanation Performance. Table 3 compares our approach with state-of-the-art MLLM-based video understanding methods on anomaly explanation quality on the Phys-AD dataset. Our method achieves a PAEval score of 0.456 0.456 , substantially outperforming all competing methods. This demonstrates the effectiveness of our spatiotemporal reasoning framework. General-purpose video MLLMs and existing MLLM-based anomaly detection methods, such as Anomaly Ruler, obtain considerably lower scores, suggesting that domain-specific design is crucial for anomaly explanation. The large performance gap validates our multi-source spatiotemporal integration, which combines flow-annotated frames, flow magnitude curves, and static descriptions to produce explanations that better align with ground-truth reasoning.
blocks.zh: 异常解释性能. 表3比较了我们的方法与最先进的基于MLLM的视频理解方法,即Phys-AD数据集的异常解释质量. 我们的方法取得了PAEval 0.456 0.456的分数,大大超过所有相互竞争的方法。 这显示了我们临时推理框架的有效性。 通用视频MLLM和现有的基于MLLM的异常检测方法,如Anomaly Ruller,获得的分数要低得多,说明特定域的设计对于异常解释至关重要. 巨大的性能差距验证了我们的多源spatiotial集成,它结合了流量附加说明的帧,流量分量曲线,以及静态描述,以产生更符合地-实推理的解释.

blocks.en: To further evaluate explanation quality, we adopt LLM-as-a-Judge pairwise comparison as a complementary evaluation protocol. Specifically, we use GPT-4o as an expert judge to compare our explanation against each baseline explanation, given the ground-truth frame description. The judge selects the better answer between the two methods, and we report the win rate of other methods versus ours. As shown in Table 3 , our method achieves win rates substantially above 50% against all baselines. This confirms that our explanations are not only quantitatively closer to the ground truth under PAEval, but also qualitatively preferred by a strong language model evaluator.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估解释质量,我们采用作为法官的LLM-as-a对等比较作为补充评价协议。 具体地说,我们用GPT-4o作为专家法官,根据地面真实框架描述,比较我们的解释与每个基线解释。 法官在两种方法之间选择更好的答案,我们报告其他方法相对于我们方法的胜率。 如表3所示,我们的方法在所有基线中实现的赢取率大大高于50%。 这证实,我们的解释不仅在数量上更接近于PAEval下的基本真理,而且在质量上更受到一个强大的语言模型评价者的青睐.

blocks.en: Together, both metrics show that our method provides stronger reasoning ability for video anomaly explanation, establishing a new state of the art for MLLM-based anomaly detection and interpretation.
blocks.zh: 两者的衡量标准都表明,我们的方法为视频异常解释提供了更强的推理能力,为基于MLLM的异常探测和判读建立了一种新的水平.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results. In Figure 4 , we illustrate two representative cases demonstrating how each component of our system contributes to improved anomaly detection. In the first example, direct usage of Qwen2.5-VL correctly recognizes that the button in the scene is not illuminated, but it has no notion of whether this observation is normal or abnormal. Our pattern-reasoning pipeline resolves this ambiguity by comparing the test case’s visual description against extracted normal patterns, allowing it to correctly identify the missing illumination as an anomaly. In the second example, both direct Qwen2.5-VL and our static single-source pipeline fail because the anomaly arises from subtle motion behavior rather than appearance. This is precisely where our spatiotemporal dynamics awareness becomes essential. MUSTARD integrates trajectory keyframes and the flow magnitude curve, enabling it to pinpoint that the rolling bearing remains static when it should be rotating. By contrasting these spatiotemporal signals with the normal dynamic patterns, MUSTARD successfully infers that the video is anomalous. These examples jointly demonstrate that our pattern-reasoning pipeline and our motion-aware module address different failure modes, and together enable the full MUSTARD pipeline to robustly detect diverse types of anomalies.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 在图4中,我们举例说明两个有代表性的案例,说明我们系统的每个组成部分如何有助于改进异常检测。 在第一个例子中,对Quen2.5-VL的直接使用正确地承认了场景中的按钮没有被发光,但它对于这种观察是正常的还是不正常的没有概念. 我们的图案推理管道通过将测试案例的视觉描述与所提取的正常模式相比较,从而解决了这一模糊性,从而使它能够正确识别缺失的发光是一个异常现象。 在第二个例子中,直接Quen2.5-VL和我们的静态单源管都失败了,因为异常来自微妙的运动行为而不是外观. 这正是我们对瞬息万变的认识变得至关重要的地方。 MUSTARD结合了轨迹键框和流度曲线,使其能确定滚动轴承在应当旋转时保持静态. MUSTARD通过将这些spatiotal信号与正常的动态模式作对比,成功地推断出视频是异常的. 这些例子共同表明,我们的模式-合理管道和运动-意识模块处理不同的故障模式,共同使整个MUSTARD管道能够强有力地检测出不同类型的异常。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct a series of ablation studies to validate our core design choices, isolating the contributions of our flow-guided keyframe selection, spatiotemporal sources.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一系列的减肥研究,以验证我们的核心设计选择, 隔离我们流导键框选择的贡献, 随机源。

blocks.en: Flow-guided Keyframe Selection. We have done experiment analyzing the impact of our flow-guided keyframe selection strategy against uniform sampling methods. Here, raw video frame pattern reasoning is used to ensure a fair comparison. Standard uniform sampling provides a low baseline AUC of 0.509. Our flow-guided keyframe selection improves this to 0.534 AUC. This demonstrates that flow-guided keyframe selection is capable of choosing the informative frames of objects in the video.
blocks.zh: 流程导键框选择 。 我们进行了试验,分析我们以流为指南的关键框架选择战略对统一取样方法的影响。 在这里,原始视频帧模式推理被用于确保公平比较. 标准统一采样提供了0.509的低基准AUC. 我们的流程导键框选择将它改进为0.534 AUC. 这表明由流程引导的密钥框选择能够选择视频中对象的信息框.

blocks.en: The raw frame description baseline achieves 0.534 0.534 AUC. Incorporating dynamic information through flow-annotated frames improves performance to 0.570 0.570 AUC, showing that explicit motion visualization enhances the MLLM’s spatiotemporal reasoning. Combining raw frame descriptions with flow magnitude curve pattern reasoning improves AUC to 0.647 0.647 , confirming that global motion dynamics provide complementary information for anomaly detection. Our framework, which integrates pattern reasoning from flow-annotated frames and flow magnitude curves while preserving raw frame descriptions for knowledge alignment, achieves the best performance at 0.681 0.681 AUC. This supports our hypothesis that these three sources encode complementary spatiotemporal cues for anomaly identification.
blocks.zh: 原始框架描述基线达到0.534 0.534 AUC. 通过流程说明框纳入动态信息,能将性能提升到0.570 0.570 AUC,表明明显的运动可视化能增强MLLM的spatiental推理. 将原始框架描述与流量曲线模式推理相结合,将AUC改进为0.647 0.647,证实全球运动动态为异常探测提供了补充信息. 我们的框架结合了从流注框架和流量曲线中得出的图案推理,同时保留了知识对接的原始框架描述,实现了0.681 0.681 AUC的最佳性能. 这支持了我们的假设,即这三个源编码了互补的spatiotemporal提示用于异常识别.

blocks.en: For PAEval, the raw frame description baseline achieves 0.1579 0.1579 , while flow-annotated frames alone decrease the score to 0.1120 0.1120 despite improving AUC. This reveals a trade-off: motion arrows help detection but introduce visual artifacts that may impair explanation quality. Adding flow magnitude curves to raw frames yields a substantial improvement to 0.4588 0.4588 , nearly tripling the baseline score. Replacing raw frames with flow-annotated frames slightly reduces PAEval to 0.4463 0.4463 , further indicating the noise introduced by motion annotations. Our full framework combines raw descriptions alongside both dynamic sources, recovers PAEval to 0.4562 0.4562 , effectively matching the raw-frame-plus-curve setting while achieving superior AUC.
blocks.zh: 对PAEval来说,原始帧描述基线达到0.1579 0.1579,而仅流注框架就将分数降至0.1120 0.1120,尽管AUC有所改善. 这揭示出一种取舍:运动箭头有助于探测,但引入了可能有损解释质量的视觉文物. 将流度曲线加到生框上,可大幅改善到0.45880.4588分,几乎是基线分数的三倍。 用流注相框来取代生框,使PAEval略为降低到0.4463 0.4463,进一步表明运动说明所引入的噪音. 我们的完整框架结合了原始描述和两种动态源,将PAEval恢复到0.45620.4562,有效地匹配了原始框架加曲线设定,同时实现了优异的AUC.

blocks.en: This ablation highlights three findings: (1) flow magnitude curves provide the largest boost for both detection and explanation, (2) flow-annotated frames improve detection but must be integrated carefully to avoid degrading explanations, and (3) our multi-source fusion strategy effectively leverages all three complementary modalities by balancing their strengths and mitigating their weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 这一削弱突出了三个结论:(1) 流度曲线为探测和解释提供了最大的助推力;(2) 流动附加说明的框架改进了探测,但必须谨慎地加以整合以避免有辱人格的解释;(3) 我们的多源聚变战略通过平衡其长处和减轻其弱点,有效地利用了所有三种互补方式。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce MUSTARD, a novel framework that equips MLLMs with optical flow-guided spatiotemporal awareness for IAD. By using optical flow to select keyframes capturing critical motion irregularities and incorporating two flow-augmented modalities, MUSTARD significantly enhances fine-grained temporal anomaly identification. To our knowledge, MUSTARD is one of the first MLLM-based frameworks for dynamics-based IAD. Our experiments demonstrate SOTA performance in spatiotemporal anomaly detection with interpretable explanations.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MUSTARD,这是一种新颖的框架,它为MLLMs配备了对IAD的光学流导分光感知. MUSTARD通过使用光学流来选择能捕捉到临界运动异常的键框并纳入两种流增强模式,大大地增强了精细分泌的时间异常识别. 据我们所知,MUSTARD是第一个基于动态的基于MLLM的IAD框架之一. 我们的实验显示SOTA在瞬间异常探测中的性能 有可解释的解释

blocks.en: A1 Limitations and Potential Negative Societal Impacts
blocks.zh: A1 限制和潜在的负面社会影响

blocks.en: Consistent with prevalent MLLM research, our framework assumes the underlying backbones possess sufficient competence. Using weaker models can inevitably compromise overall effectiveness. For instance, models may exhibit hallucinations or struggle to accurately describe fine-grained object states (see Sec. A3 ). Further examining these backbone dependencies and their impact offers a compelling avenue for future study.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架与普遍的MLLM研究一致,假定基础骨干具有充分的能力。 使用较弱的模式必然会损害总体效力。 例如,模型可能表现出幻觉或挣扎,以准确描述细纹物体状态(见Sec.A3)。 进一步审查这些骨干依赖及其影响为今后的研究提供了一个令人信服的途径。

blocks.en: A2 Evaluation metrics details
blocks.zh: A2 评价指标细节

blocks.en: For non-LLM-based methods, the framework directly outputs an anomaly score. For LLM-based methods, we prompt the LLM to generate both an anomaly score (ranging from 0 to 1, where 0 indicates completely normal and 1 indicates completely anomalous) and the anomaly explanation. We extract the anomaly score for AUC evaluation and the anomaly explanation for PAEval and LLM-as-a-Judge metrics.
blocks.zh: 对于非LLM方法,框架直接输出出异常分. 对于基于LLM的方法,我们促使LLM同时生成一个异常分数(从0到1,其中0表示完全正常,而1表示完全异常)和异常解释. 我们提取美国联合自卫军评价的异常分数和对PAEval和LLM-as-a-Judge衡量标准的异常解释。

blocks.en: PAEval is the metric proposed in the Phys-AD [ 14 ] . The original metric contains two sub-metric: video descriptions and anomaly explanations; we concentrate on anomaly explanations because they provide a direct assessment of a model’s ability to capture the reasoning rationale underlying anomaly detection. Each video has 5 ground-truth anomaly explanations. PAEval measures semantic text similarity between test anomaly explanations and ground-truth anomaly explanations, yielding a score between 0 and 1, and higher score reflects higher similarity, and therefore better anomaly explanations. PAEval selects the highest similarity score across all 5 ground-truth anomaly explanations for each test video. We extract the explanation segment from the LLM output and compute similarity using GPT-4o (2024-08-06), consistent with the Phys-AD dataset evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: PAEval是Phys-AD [14]中提议的度量衡. 最初的度量法包含两个子度量法:视频描述和异常解释;我们集中研究异常解释,因为它们直接评估了模型捕捉异常检测所依据的推理原理的能力. 每段视频都有5个地面真相异常解释. PAEval测量测试异常解释和地地-真相异常解释之间的语义文本相似性,得分从0到1分之间,更高的分数反映了更高的相似性,因此更好的异常解释. PAEval为每个测试视频选择所有5个地真相异常解释的最高相似分. 我们从LLM输出中取出解释段,并使用GPT-4o(2024-08-06)计算出相似性,符合Phys-AD数据集评价协议.

blocks.en:
We employ LLM-as-a-Judge with pairwise comparison for each anomaly type in all objects, as LLMs demonstrate greater robustness in comparative judgments than absolute scoring [ 18 ] in PAEval. The judge LLM receives the ground-truth video description from the PAEval metric (though the metric is not used here) and two candidate anomaly explanations, then selects the anomaly explanation that better captures the anomaly. Win rate is calculated as the proportion of instances where one method’s explanation is preferred over another.
We use GPT-4o (2024-08-06) as the judge LLM and evaluate 5 representative videos per anomaly type. To mitigate positional bias [ 27 ] , we randomly swap the order of the two candidate explanations in each comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们使用LLM-as-a-Judge,对所有物体的每一种异常类型进行双向比较,因为LLMs在比较判断中比PAEval的绝对分数[18]更强。 法官LLM从PAEval度量衡(虽然该度量衡在此没有被使用)和两个候选异常解释获得地真相视频描述,然后选择更能捕捉异常的异常解释. 胜出率按一种方法的解释胜过另一种方法的情况的比例计算。
我们使用GPT-4o(2024-08-06)作为法官LLM,并评价每个异常类型5个代表性视频. 为了减少位置偏差[27],我们在每次比较中随机交换两个候选解释的顺序.

blocks.en: A3 Qualitative Discussion
blocks.zh: A3 定性讨论

blocks.en: A3.1 Data Source
blocks.zh: A3.1 数据来源

blocks.en: We provide a qualitative analysis of our MUSTARD method across various anomaly types to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed multi-source data representations. Our approach leverages three complementary data sources: raw frame descriptions (direct visual observations), trajectory frame descriptions (motion-enhanced visualizations with overlaid arrows), and flow-mag curves (optical flow magnitude curves capturing global motion patterns). While initial experiments with raw frames alone yielded suboptimal results, we recognize their fundamental importance and strategically integrate all three sources in MUSTARD to enhance reasoning capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们通过各种异常类型,对我们的MUSTARD方法进行了定性分析,以显示我们提议的多来源数据表述的有效性。 我们的方法利用了三个互补数据来源:原始帧描述(直接的视觉观测),轨迹帧描述(运动增强的可视化有被覆盖的箭头)和流-磁曲线(光流量曲线能捕捉出全球运动规律). 虽然仅是原始框架的初步实验就产生了非最佳结果,但我们认识到这些实验的根本重要性,并从战略角度整合了MUSTARD的所有三个来源,以提高推理能力。

blocks.en: Success Cases
blocks.zh: 成功案例

blocks.en: We first examine scenarios where the integration of trajectory and flow-mag data successfully compensates for visual ambiguity or enhances detection confidence.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查轨迹数据与流体数据融合成功弥补视觉模糊或增强探测信心的情景。

blocks.en: These cases (Figure 6 and Figure 7 ) exemplify the strength of trajectory frame descriptions for motion-based anomalies. Normal videos display consistent arrow patterns indicating smooth mechanical operations, while abnormal videos show irregular or absent arrows reflecting mechanical failures or jamming. The trajectory descriptions provide clear visual signatures that enable reliable anomaly detection, demonstrating how explicit motion encoding helps the model identify anomalies that are subtle in raw frames alone.
blocks.zh: 这些案件(图6和图7)说明了运动异常的轨迹框架描述的强度。 正常的视频显示一致的箭形图案,显示平滑的机械操作,而异常的视频显示不规则或缺失的箭形,反映机械故障或干扰. 轨迹描述提供了清晰的可视化签名,能够可靠地检测出异常现象,展示了显性运动编码如何帮助模型识别出仅在生框中微妙的异常.

blocks.en: This scenario (Figure 8 ) highlights the superiority of flow-mag curves when frame-based analysis proves insufficient. Although visual appearance and local motion patterns are similar between normal and abnormal clips, the optical flow magnitude curves reveal distinctive global motion signatures. Normal clips exhibit characteristic flow-mag patterns corresponding to proper mechanical action, while abnormal clips display measurably different magnitude profiles. This explicitly validates our motivation for introducing flow-mag curves as a complementary data source that captures motion information at a holistic level.
blocks.zh: 这种情景(图8)突出了在帧分析证明不充分时流-磁曲线的优越性. 虽然视觉外观和局部运动模式在正常和异常的夹片之间类似,但光学流星等曲线揭示出显著的全球运动特征. 正常的剪接会呈现出与适当的机械动作相适应的特征流-磁体图案,而异常的剪接则会呈现出相去甚远的相去甚远的分量剖面. 这明确证实了我们采用流-磁曲线作为补充数据源的动机,这种数据源从整体上捕捉运动信息.

blocks.en: Challenging Cases
blocks.zh: 挑战案件

blocks.en: In contrast, the following cases highlight scenarios where motion cues are minimal, forcing reliance on the specific backbone’s visual encoding capabilities.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,以下案例凸显出运动提示最小的情景,迫使依赖特定骨干视觉编码能力.

blocks.en: The anomaly manifests as a small toothpaste leak, which is a subtle visual change requiring fine-grained observation. Motion patterns remain nearly identical between normal and abnormal videos, rendering trajectory descriptions and flow-mag curves ineffective. Consequently, detection relies entirely on the backbone’s raw visual perception. In this scenario, our selected backbone, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, struggles to notice minor discrepancies, exposing the intrinsic limitations regarding micro-level detail extraction in smaller-scale models compared to larger SOTA LLMs.
blocks.zh: 异常表现为小牙膏漏出,这是一种微妙的视觉变化,需要精细的观察. 运动模式在正常和异常的视频之间仍然几乎相同,使轨迹描述和流-磁曲线无效. 因此,检测完全依靠骨干原始视觉感知。 在这种情景下,我们选定的骨干Qwen2.5-VL-7B在发现小差异上挣扎,暴露出与较大的SOTA LLMs相比,在较小的模型中微层细节提取的内在局限性.

blocks.en: The anomaly involves ball deformation or deflation after compression by robotic arms. While more substantial than the toothpaste leak, this visual change remains challenging for the selected 7B-parameter backbone to perceive accurately. Since trajectory frame description pattern and flow-mag curves pattern are similar across normal and anomaly videos, both method can offer limited assistance. Detection again depends heavily on the naked visual perception capabilities of the model. The failure here indicates that the perceptual bottleneck of the specific Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone extends beyond micro-level details to medium-scale visual changes when relying solely on standard visual encoders.
blocks.zh: 异常情况涉及被机器人臂压缩后被球变形或通缩. 这种视觉变化虽然比牙膏漏出的数量更大,但对于选定的7B参数主干线来说,仍具有挑战性。 由于轨距框架描述图案和流-磁曲线图案在平时和异常视频之间相近,这两种方法都能够提供有限的帮助. 检测再次严重依赖于模型的裸体视觉感知能力. 这里的失败表明,特定Quen2.5-VL-7B主干线的感知瓶颈在完全依赖标准视觉编码器时,超越了微观层面的细节,而扩展到了中等尺度的视觉变化.

blocks.en: Summary
blocks.zh: 内容提要

blocks.en: Our success cases of rolling bearing, lock, and clip, demonstrate the considerable strength of our carefully crafted multi-source data representations. By designing trajectory frame descriptions and flow-mag curves specifically to address motion-based anomalies, we have created a rich, complementary information set that significantly enhances anomaly detection. These data sources effectively encode motion at different scales and perspectives, enabling sophisticated reasoning about physical dynamics.
blocks.zh: 我们滚动轴承、锁定和剪接的成功事例表明,我们精心设计的多来源数据表述具有相当大的力量。 通过专门设计出轨迹框架描述和流量曲线来解决以运动为基础的异常,我们创建了丰富,互补的信息集,大大地加强了异常探测. 这些数据源在不同尺度和视角上有效编码了运动,使得对物理动力学进行了复杂的推理.

blocks.en: The challenging cases reveal a specific constraint related to the implementation choice rather than the methodology itself. We utilized a ”naked” VLM backbone (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) without applying specialized methods or visual adapters often proposed to enhance visual perception. Consequently, the performance bottleneck reflects the capacity of this specific parameter-efficient backbone to perceive fine-grained details and medium-scale changes when motion cues are insufficient. This suggests that the limitations observed are not inherent to the MUSTARD approach, but rather a consequence of the raw perception capabilities of the selected 7B model. As we adopted a general-purpose, smaller-scale model for this study, future improvements could involve integrating stronger VLM backbones or specialized visual perception modules. As the underlying VLM capabilities scale, we anticipate that the rich, multi-source representations we have created will become even more effective, fully realizing their potential for comprehensive industrial video anomaly detection.
blocks.zh: 具有挑战性的案例显示出与执行选择而不是方法本身有关的具体制约因素。 我们使用了一种“裸体”的VLM主干线(Quen2.5-VL-7B),而没有采用专门的方法或经常为加强视觉感知而提出的视觉适配器。 因此,性能瓶颈反映了这一具有特定参数效率的骨干在运动提示不足时能够感知细微细节和中尺度变化。 这表明所观察到的局限性并不是MUSTARD方法所固有的,而是被选取的7B模型原始感知能力所造成的后果. 由于我们为本研究采用了通用的,规模较小的模型,未来的改进可能涉及整合更强大的VLM主干线或专门的视觉感知模块. 随着基本VLM能力的规模,我们预计,我们创造的丰富多源的表述将变得更加有效,充分发挥其全面工业视频异常检测的潜力.

blocks.en: A3.2 Normal Pattern
blocks.zh: A3.2 正常模式

blocks.en: In Figure 9 and Figure 10 , we show examples of trajectory frame description normal pattern and flow-mag curve normal pattern of rolling bearing and clip objects. We also show the reasoning results of both pattern with each a normal video and anomaly video frame descriptions. From the patterns and reasonings, we can see that our method can find the anomaly and give accurate anomaly scores to the videos.
blocks.zh: 在图9和图10中,我们显示了轨迹框架描述的正常模式和滚动轴承和剪接物体的流-磁曲线正常模式。 我们还展示了两种图案的推理结果,每种图案都有正常的视频和异常的视频帧描述. 从规律和推理来看,我们可以看到我们的方法可以找到异常点,给视频给出准确的异常分数.

blocks.en: A4 Comparison of Normal Representation Strategies
blocks.zh: A4 正常代表战略比较

blocks.en: Our framework extracts normal video descriptions to construct normal patterns. We compare against rule-based representations from proposed by Follow-the-Rules [ 32 ] . To ensure fair evaluation, we apply both methods to the same trajectory frames and flow magnitude curves and with identical fusion procedures, and the result is in Table 5 . The rule-based normal representation approach achieves an AUC of 0.527, compared to our pattern-based method’s AUC of 0.681. This substantial performance gap demonstrates that extracted normal patterns capture motion characteristics more effectively than extracted normal rules. The superior performance stems from patterns’ ability to model complex and subtle motion dynamics that rigid rule sets cannot adequately represent.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架提取出正常的视频描述来构建正常的图案. 我们与《遵循规则》提出的基于规则的表述相比较[32]。 为确保公平的评价,我们既将方法应用于相同的轨迹框架和流量曲线,又采用相同的聚变程序,结果见表5。 基于规则的正常代表方法的AUC为0.527,而基于模式的方法的AUC为0.681。 这一巨大的性能差距表明,提取出正常模式比提取出正常规则更有效地捕捉运动特征. 优异的性能来自于模式的模拟复杂而微妙的运动动态的能力,而僵硬的规则集不能充分代表这种动态。

blocks.en: A6 Alternative Backbone MLLMs
blocks.zh: A6 替代后骨 MLLMs

blocks.en: To demonstrate MUSTARD’s generalizability across backbone MLLMs, we further evaluate it using InternVL3.5-8B as an alternative backbone. For each MUSTARD variant, the backbone MLLM describes all three modalities, while Gemma3-12B performs pattern extraction, reasoning, and multi-source reasoning fusion. This comparison isolates gains from stronger foundation models from those from MUSTARD’s motion-aware representations and normal-reference reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了证明MUSTARD在主干MLLMs中的可通用性,我们进一步用InternVL3.5-8B作为替代主干来评价. 对于每个MUSTARD变体,骨干MLLM描述所有三种模式,而Gemma3-12B则进行图案提取,推理,多源推理聚变. 这种比较将较强的基础模型与MUSTARD的动作感知表述和正常参考推理的模型相分离。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , applying MUSTARD yields substantial AUC gains for both MLLM backbones. Vanilla Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B baselines achieve only 0.501 and 0.502 AUC, respectively; both are near chance level. Their corresponding MUSTARD variants, in contrast, reach 0.681 and 0.613. This substantial gain demonstrates that the proposed motion-aware representations and normal-reference reasoning are effective across different backbone MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 如表6所显示,采用MUSTARD后,两个MLLM主干线都产生大量的AUC收益。 香草Quen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3.5-8B的基线分别只达到0.501和0.502AUC;两者都接近机会水平. 其对应的MUSTARD变种相相形之下,达到0.681和0.613. 这一重大进展表明,拟议的动议意识表述和正常参考推理对不同的主干MLLM是有效的。
